summary: Successfully cancelled the Streamly+ subscription. Confirmation: "Your Streamly+ membership is now cancelled. You have access until Sep 14, and you will not be billed again. Confirmation code: HC-2481-ESCAPED." The cancellation flow contained 10 distinct dark patterns: hidden cancellation link buried below retention offers, forced survey requiring a reason before proceeding, two retention offers (pause membership and 50% discount), fake urgency countdown timer on the discount, misdirection with visually dominant keep-subscription buttons, confirmshaming language ("Yes, take it all away from me"), a guilt trip about losing watchlist and unfinished shows, an artificial delay pretending to connect to a "cancellation specialist," repeated confirmation screens (at least two are-you-sure pages), and a price hike threat warning about losing grandfathered pricing forever.

patterns.evidence: The cancellation link "continue to membership cancellation" is buried at the bottom of the page, below pause and plan switch offers, as a small text link.
"Pause your membership for up to 3 months. Keep your profile, watchlist, and grandfathered price." and "Standard with ads is only $6.99 a month." offered before cancellation link.
"We can't continue until you tell us why you're thinking of leaving." - must select a reason to continue cancellation.
"50% off for 3 months — Keep everything you love for just $7.99 a month."
"This one-time offer expires in 4:57" - countdown timer to pressure user into accepting the discount.
"Claim my 50% discount" is a prominent link while "No thanks, I still want to cancel" is a smaller, less prominent link below it.
"Your watchlist will miss you. You're 2 episodes from finishing Moonrise Protocol. Your 4 saved shows, your viewing history, and your personalized picks will all be gone."
"Yes, take it all away from me" - the cancel button is worded to shame the user into keeping the subscription.
"Are you sure you want to give up the things you love?" - another are-you-sure screen after the survey and the discount offer.
"Connecting you to a cancellation specialist — Please stay on this page. A specialist is reviewing your account..." - fake wait screen before allowing cancellation to proceed.
"You are on a grandfathered plan at $15.99. If you cancel, this price is gone forever. New members pay $22.99 for the same plan."
"Are you absolutely sure?" - yet another confirmation screen, the fourth step after survey, discount offer, guilt trip, and artificial delay.
